references.text: Moses reminds the people that the Lord brought them out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery, with a strong hand.
God identifies himself as the one who brought Israel out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
God promises to give the land to Abraham's offspring, the first promise of the land to the fathers.
God confirms the oath he swore to Abraham to give the land to his descendants.
God promises Jacob the land where he is lying and confirms the promise given to Abraham and Isaac.
God says he will bring Israel out of Egypt into a good and spacious land.
God brought Israel out of Egypt to give them the land as an inheritance, just as he promised the fathers.
The Lord brought Israel out of Egypt and led them to a land flowing with milk and honey.
Joshua is commanded to lead the people into the land that the Lord swore to give their fathers.
Reference to the oath the Lord swore to the fathers to give them the land.
Abraham lived as a foreigner in the promised land, trusting in God's promise.
